items.news_title: After backlash, Adobe cancels Adobe Animate shutdown and puts app on ‘maintenance mode’
items.news_summary: Adobe reverses decision to shut down Animate software after customer backlash, puts it in maintenance mode instead of discontinuing it in 2026. Company initially planned shutdown to focus on AI.

comic.panel_description: A nervous corporate suit stands at a podium labeled 'Adobe' trying to pull back a paper announcement that reads 'DISCONTINUING ANIMATE' while an angry mob of artists and animators with digital tablets and pencils shake their fists. In the corner, a small AI robot looks confused.
comic.caption: The Great Animation Un-cancellation Show
comic.image_prompt: Editorial cartoon style, black ink line art with minimal color, showing corporate executive at podium facing crowd, common man style simplified faces, dramatic expressions, newspaper cartoon aesthetic, clean lines, cross-hatching for shadows, RK Laxman inspired composition
comic.negative_prompt: Adobe logo, real executives, specific people, blood, violence, corporate logos, photorealistic faces, modern digital art style
comic.layout_notes: Caption below image, crowd arranged in bottom half, executive elevated on podium stage left, AI robot small in corner stage right

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes Adobe's hasty reversal on discontinuing Animate after customer outrage. It highlights the disconnect between corporate AI-focused strategies and the actual needs of creative professionals. The visual metaphor of physically trying to pull back an announcement paper represents the company's awkward attempt to undo a poorly received decision.

safety_checks.notes: Avoids specific individuals or corporate representation beyond generic suit figure. Keeps conflict comical rather than threatening.

items.news_title: HC issues notices to Bar Council of India and A.P. on plea for 33% quota for women advocates
items.news_source: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
items.news_summary: Andhra Pradesh High Court considers petition for 33% quota for women lawyers in Bar Association elections. Court issues notices to Bar Council seeking response.

comic.panel_description: A large courtroom scale shows male lawyer figures heavily weighing down one side while female lawyer figures struggle on the other. A blindfolded Lady Justice tries adjusting the scale with her sword while her blindfold slips, revealing one eye peeking at the imbalance.
comic.caption: Justice may be blind, but the numbers don't lie
comic.image_prompt: Indian editorial cartoon style, black ink line art, single panel showing Lady Justice with sliding blindfold, large ornate balance scale, simplified lawyer figures in black robes, minimal watercolor wash, cross-hatched shadows, RK Laxman inspired composition, newspaper aesthetic
comic.negative_prompt: realistic faces, specific people, court logos, violent imagery, modern technology, color photography, detailed backgrounds
comic.layout_notes: Caption centered below panel, scale dominates center frame, Lady Justice figure on right side, lawyer figures arranged on scale pans left and right

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon uses the iconic symbol of Lady Justice to highlight the current gender imbalance in legal institutions. By showing her peeking through her blindfold, it suggests the system is aware of but slow to address obvious disparities. The tipped scale visualizes the statistical disparity while playing with the double meaning of justice and balance.

safety_checks.notes: Avoids targeting individuals, uses universal symbols, keeps criticism institutional rather than personal

items.news_title: Building in AI this year? This is the room to be in
items.news_summary: A tech article discusses how AI hackathons are becoming serious business venues where real products are developed, rather than just experimental spaces for tinkering.

comic.panel_description: A large corporate conference room where suited executives sit around a table with laptops, while robots in business attire pitch presentations. In the corner, a confused-looking common man watches as one robot serves tea while another updates a whiteboard with complex AI algorithms.
comic.caption: Welcome to the board meeting - both artificial and intelligent!
comic.image_prompt: Indian editorial cartoon style, black ink line art with minimal color, conference room scene with corporate robots and humans in suits, RK Laxman style common man watching from corner, whimsical expressions, detailed cross-hatching, simple clean lines, vintage newspaper aesthetic
comic.negative_prompt: realistic faces, specific tech companies, brand logos, complex backgrounds, photorealism, modern tech devices
comic.layout_notes: Caption below panel, common man positioned in bottom right corner as observer, main action centered on conference table, speech bubbles minimal

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes the rapid corporatization of AI development by depicting robots literally taking seats at the boardroom table. It plays on the irony of artificial intelligence becoming so mainstream that it's now just another business meeting participant. The common man's bewildered expression represents the public's mix of awe and concern about AI's integration into corporate culture.

safety_checks.notes: Generic business setting, no specific companies or individuals referenced, suitable for general audience

items.news_title: India ace record chase to make Under-19 World Cup final
items.news_summary: India's Under-19 cricket team chases down record target of 311 runs to reach World Cup final, overcoming early dropped catches and making history.

comic.panel_description: A young cricket batsman stands at crease, appearing small against towering scoreboard showing '311'. Behind him, a mountain peak labeled 'Record Chase' has his team's flag planted halfway up, while teammates form human ladder helping him climb. A bewildered Afghan bowler watches.
comic.caption: Breaking records? Just another day at youth camp!
comic.image_prompt: Editorial cartoon style, black ink line art with minimal watercolor, showing cricket ground with exaggerated scoreboard, determined young batsman, mountain metaphor, human pyramid of players, Common Man watching from boundary, RK Laxman influenced simple lines, newspaper illustration aesthetic
comic.negative_prompt: photorealistic faces, team logos, specific player likenesses, cricket brands, violence, aggressive poses, political symbols
comic.layout_notes: Caption below panel, mountain metaphor dominates upper third, cricket ground perspective from side angle, Common Man in lower right corner

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon uses the metaphor of mountain climbing to represent breaking the record chase in cricket. The human ladder of teammates represents the collaborative effort, while the small size of the batsman against the scoreboard highlights the seeming impossibility of the task. The casual attitude in the caption underscores how India's youth teams routinely accomplish extraordinary feats.

safety_checks.notes: Generic representation of teams, no individual likenesses, sporting achievement focus
